about_the_game:
On the basis of the original plot, a plot has been added after the male lead and the female leads have been confirmed. Added prop system and various Easter egg gameplay.

Players will start panoramic love with many beautiful women who can be cool and cute and pure or desirable from the first perspective. Encountering, getting to know, and falling in love with them of various shapes and colors, experiencing countless possibilities and multiple facets of love.

Every choice you make will lead to a completely different chemical reaction from 'her'; Every entanglement, honey like love is entangled and pulled; With their pounding hearts, spinning like an endless dance. Fate quietly arrives, and various beautiful women take turns to appear. Come and embark on this passionate and exciting love!

[Product Features]

1. A romantic experience with a sense of breathing

First person live action filming, with professional actors playing throughout the game, creating a realistic and tangible atmosphere of love while players explore the game, allowing players to fully experience a breathing love.

2. Fun and imaginative interactions

As the plot develops, you will engage in various imaginative and fun games with 7 female leads, picking cilantro, interactive answering questions, dodging the pursuit of the dormitory management auntie, chatting with her with "micro movements", collecting his beautiful photos, and scrolling through her "shaking" videos Beyond love, joy never ceases!

3. Million word plot interpretation for a more comprehensive experience duration

In the regular gameplay process, this game has added more gameplay, innovative gameplay experience and complex plot bring higher degrees of freedom, rich exploration mixed with delicate character lines, giving players a more immersive gaming experience.

4:30+Ending, Explore Unexpected Heartbeat Moments

The six girls, regardless of their personalities, all have room for exploration and reversal. With each step of in-depth understanding, there are unexpected developments waiting for players. The richly layered characters bring a sense of real love, and unconsciously, they experience the true excitement.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains a small amount of exposed clothing (but does not expose sensitive areas)
